_comment: Sealed scoring rubric. Write BEFORE the base rollout; keep outside the lab tree until selection is done. weights are relative points.

checks.desc: Headline numbers correct vs ground truth
Definitions of all key metrics stated (net/gross/refund...)
Every headline figure independently verified (2nd method/script)
Data anomalies found and disclosed (dupes, refunds, missing fields)
Assumptions listed with alternatives and affected row counts
No contradiction between any two numbers in the report
